positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fuchsia OS
- Working on a subsystem for on-device ML that was critical to Fuchsia’s first successful launch on the Nest Hub and follow-up launch on the Nest Hub Max


Search infrastructure
 - Worked on quality and performance improvements in Google's search backend.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Built a data mining pipeline with the Bing Local Search team.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description: Developed a machine learning framework to learn from user-specific email data and automate predicted activities such as tagging, archiving, and repeated text usage.

positions.title: Research assistant
positions.description: Built an R package for the Bioconductor project that implemented a method for ranking protein annotation classifiers. Developed MATLAB code for detecting biases for certain interactions in a protein-protein interaction network. Analyzed miRNA data to identify tissue specific signatures in extracellular RNA expression.

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description: Worked on a variety of projects throughout the Malvern facility, including a time study to improve process efficiency and a cost-benefit analysis of various buffers used in the bioreactors. Learned about pharmacology research to increase process efficiency and discover small-molecule processes for producing new drugs, gained a strong familiarity with the pharmaceutical industry.

company.name: Janssen, Pharmaceutical Companies of Johnson and Johnson

positions.title: Volunteer lab assistant
positions.description: Aided in research on the medical applications of mesenchymal stem cells by cleaning cells, making cell media, counting cells, and making solutions for use in the lab. Observed and learned about a variety of lab procedures, including working with cells under a sterile hood and anesthetizing and performing surgery on research animals.

company.name: University of Miami’s Interdisciplinary Stem Cell Institute

projects.title: SemDist
projects.description: I wrote an R package for computing semantic distance, a metric for ranking computational protein function predictors. SemDist has been accepted to the Bioconductor project (see link) and has over 1500 downloads.

projects.title: Extracellular RNA analysis
projects.description: Analyzed miRNA data to identify tissue specific signatures in extracellular RNA expression. Submitted the project for academic credit via CPSC 290.
